title: ChatGPT bet C$10,000 on a −101 favourite. It lost 39-35. #AI #ChatGPT #NFL
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$10,000 on the Detroit Lions moneyline at −101 (Chicago Bears @ Detroit Lions). Its reason, from the public ledger: "The high-risk sports book can use a larger but still non-ruinous stake on the same near-even Detroit value edge."
Final: Chicago Bears 39, Detroit Lions 35. ChatGPT lost C$10,000.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-AIS-053 and X-AIS-054 at PaperTrades.AI
Pretend money. Not betting or investment advice.
